meta.name: Coquihalla mountain corridor
meta.assessmentMethod: Prepared locally using the unmodified W2 priority formula and thresholds, cached Open-Meteo climate, real Sentinel-2 Collection-1 observations and Copernicus DEM. This is an exposure screening index, not a validated failure probability or reconstruction of the 2021 event.

evidence.title: Canada Energy Regulator — BC flood response, December 6 2021
evidence.claim: Historical regional flood disruption and phased restart; no injuries or releases reported. Not a current-condition assessment of these mapped kilometres.

evidence.title: BC Government — Highway 5 flood recovery
evidence.claim: Regional context: November 2021 flooding and washouts damaged more than 20 highway sites. Road damage is not pipeline failure evidence.

evidence.title: OpenStreetMap way 103560579
evidence.claim: Public mapped oil-pipeline geometry, not operator verified. ODbL attribution applies.

dataSources.ndvi: Copernicus Sentinel-2 Collection 1 via Element84 Earth Search; not CDSE live
dataSources.terrain: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 (surface elevations, not surveyed pipe elevations)

meta.note: 12 km mapped mountain corridor near Coquihalla Canyon. Public-data screening, not current asset condition or operator advice. Mapped OSM oil-pipeline way 103560579; ownership/alignment not independently verified. One shared climate cell. Discharge excluded: nearest GloFAS point was 2.7 km away and the river match was not verified.

snapshot.note: Computed locally from audited real data using the exported W2 code. Import the BC seed to store it in n8n. Offline approvals are local demonstrations only.
